_doc: Keepsakes: small run modifiers a Basecamp NPC gives once their affinity (Dialogue.affinity(giver), 0..5, raised by offerings) reaches min_affinity. One keepsake can be carried per run, chosen at the hellgate loadout. effects use the Meta upgrade effect format: {stat, amount} -> Player.apply_stat; {type: soul_gain, amount} -> extra soul multiplier for the run; {type: run_stat, stat, amount} -> Progression.apply_stat (luck, rerolls, banishes, dash_charges, ichor_gain, shard_gain). See docs/team/basecamp.md.
